Package org.geysermc.paletter.block

Record Class CustomBlock

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.block.CustomBlock
Record Components:
identifier - the block identifier (description identifier)
properties - the state properties (description states), in declaration order
traits - the traits (description traits); the states they add are part of states()
components - the base components (one per component name)
permutations - components applied when a Molang condition on the state holds
menuCategory - the description's menu_category, or null: then it follows creative(), else none
item - how the block item is registered
creative - where the block item goes in the creative inventory, or null to leave it out
defaultStates - state values of the default state; properties not listed use their first value
tags - block tags, queryable with Molang (sent as the block's blockTags)
public record CustomBlock(@NonNull String identifier, @NonNull List<BlockProperty<?>> properties, @NonNull List<BlockTrait> traits, @NonNull List<BlockComponent> components, @NonNull List<CustomBlock.Permutation> permutations, @Nullable MenuCategory menuCategory, @NonNull CustomBlock.BlockItem item, @Nullable CreativePlacement creative, @NonNull Map<String,Object> defaultStates, @NonNull List<String> tags) extends Record
A custom (data driven) block: an add-on JSON minecraft:block in Java. Registering one in a layer generates its states, its block property data, its block item and its creative entry; runtime ids and palette ordering are handled by the palette. 

 CustomBlock lamp = CustomBlock.builder("example:lamp")
     .property(BlockProperty.bool("example:lit"))
     .trait(PlacementDirection.builder().enabledStates(PlacementDirection.EnabledStates.CARDINAL_DIRECTION).build())
     .component(Geometry.of("minecraft:geometry.full_block"))
     .component(MaterialInstances.builder().all(MaterialInstances.Instance.builder().texture("lamp").build()).build())
     .permutation("q.block_state('example:lit')", LightEmission.of(15))
     .creative(CreativePlacement.loose(CreativeCategory.CONSTRUCTION))
     .build();
Since:
1.0.0
